title: Happy jar sheet
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y3 lesson 7 (Happy jar sheet (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 7: Feeling happy: what helps us feel good. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: All feelings are normal
points: We can choose what we do

panels.title: Things that help us feel good

box.title: Draw a big jar. Inside, write or draw five things you are grateful to Allah for.

keywords.def: how we feel inside, like happy, sad or worried

questions.q: Show me three things that make you happy.
questions.a: Any three (for example: playing with my brother, reading, helping cook).

questions.q: Show me the breathing: in for 4, out for 4.
Core: Make a 'happy jar' sheet: write or draw five things you are grateful for (pupil PDF).
Extend: Write one kind thing you will do for someone this week.
questions.a: For example: help set the table.

questions.q: Stretch: Explain why helping others can make us feel good too.
questions.a: It brings us closer to others and to Allah, and we feel useful.

questions.q: You feel cross. What is a good first step?
questions.a: B) Stop and breathe slowly. Breathing slowly calms the body so we can choose what to do next.

questions.q: Shukr means... A) thankfulness B) anger C) sleep
Big question: name one thing that helps you feel good.
questions.a: For example: helping someone, saying Alhamdulillah.
